scenario.title: 要留在台北，還是搬去花東？
scenario.context: 討論生活選擇時，常會說「越…就越…」：住得越遠，房租越便宜；工作越多，壓力越大。英文用 the + 比較級, the + 比較級 表達這種連動關係，結構很特別，兩個 the 都不能少。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: I'm seriously thinking of moving to Hualien.
lines.zh: 我認真在考慮搬去花蓮。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.zh: 真的嗎？那你的工作怎麼辦？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: I can work remotely. I'm tired of the rat race. The longer I stay in Taipei, the more stressed I get.
lines.zh: 我可以遠端工作。我受夠了這種你爭我奪的生活。在台北待得越久，我壓力就越大。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I get it. But the farther you move, the harder it is to see friends.
lines.zh: 我懂。但你搬得越遠，要見朋友就越難。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: True. But the cheaper the rent, the more I can save.
lines.zh: 也對。但房租越便宜，我能存的就越多。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Just don't move to the middle of nowhere. You'll go crazy.
lines.zh: 只是別搬到荒郊野外，你會瘋掉。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Don't worry. I'm looking at places near the city center.
lines.zh: 別擔心，我在看市中心附近的房子。

dialogues.title: Visiting a friend in the countryside

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Wow, it's so quiet here. All I can hear are birds.
lines.zh: 哇，這裡好安靜，只聽得到鳥叫。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Welcome to the sticks! The nearest 7-Eleven is twenty minutes away.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到鄉下！最近的 7-Eleven 要二十分鐘。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: After living in a concrete jungle for so long, this feels like heaven.
lines.zh: 在水泥叢林住了那麼久，這裡感覺像天堂。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The more time you spend here, the less you want to go back.
lines.zh: 你在這待得越久，就越不想回去。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I believe it. Do you miss anything about the city?
lines.zh: 我相信。你會懷念城市的什麼嗎？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Food delivery. And bubble tea at midnight.

patterns.en: The cost of living is so high here.
I need a slower pace of life.
patterns.zh: 我需要慢一點的生活步調。

patterns.en: It's a great place to raise kids.
You need a car to get around.
It's the best of both worlds.

chinglish.right: The farther you go, the cheaper it gets.
chinglish.why: 「越…越…」直翻缺了 the 和主詞動詞。英文結構是 the + 比較級 + 主詞 + 動詞。

chinglish.wrong: The more I work, the more I tired.
chinglish.right: The more I work, the more tired I get.
chinglish.why: 兩個子句都要有完整的主詞和動詞；tired 是形容詞，要搭配 get / feel。

chinglish.right: The air in the countryside is fresher.
chinglish.why: fresh 是一音節，比較級用 fresher。

chinglish.wrong: I want to go back to my hometown to develop.
chinglish.right: I want to move back to my hometown and start something there.
chinglish.why: 「回鄉發展」直翻 develop 很模糊。

grammar.title: the more…, the more…
grammar.oneLiner: The + 比較級 + 主詞 + 動詞, the + 比較級 + 主詞 + 動詞：表達兩件事一起增加或減少。
whenToUse: 基本結構：The more you practice, the better you get.
形容詞比較級：The cheaper the rent, the more I can save.
less：The less you sleep, the worse you feel.
口語可以省略動詞：The sooner, the better.（越快越好）/ The more, the merrier.（人越多越熱鬧）
兩個 the 都不能省略。
注意形容詞和名詞的位置：The more money you make, the more you spend.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「越…越…」結構非常簡單，直接把形容詞或動詞放進去就好：「越遠越便宜」。英文則需要 the + 比較級，而且兩邊都要有主詞和動詞。台灣人常省略 the，或忘了把形容詞變成比較級。

examples.correct: The more you read, the more you learn.
examples.incorrect: More you read, more you learn.

examples.correct: The older I get, the less I care what people think.
The bigger the city, the higher the rent.
examples.note: 省略 be 動詞的形式。

examples.correct: The sooner we leave, the better.
The more people come, the merrier.
examples.note: 固定說法：人越多越熱鬧。

quiz.question: ___ you practice, the better you'll get.
The farther we drove, ___ the roads became.
The ___ I sleep, the worse I feel. (越少)
Come early. The sooner, the ___.
quiz.explanation: The sooner, the better. = 越快越好。

quiz.question: Which is correct?
options: The more I work, the more I tired.
The more I work, the more tired I get.
quiz.explanation: 兩邊都要有完整主詞動詞。

slang.meaning: 你爭我奪的忙碌都市生活
slang.usage: 形容為了錢和成就不停競爭、疲於奔命的生活。escape the rat race = 逃離這種生活。

examples.en: He quit the rat race and opened a café by the sea.
examples.zh: 他退出競爭生活，在海邊開了間咖啡店。

examples.en: I'm tired of the rat race.
examples.zh: 我厭倦了這種你爭我奪的生活。

slang.meaning: 荒郊野外、鳥不生蛋的地方
slang.usage: 形容偏僻、什麼都沒有的地方。

risk.note: 帶點誇飾，說別人的老家是 the middle of nowhere 要看交情。

examples.en: Our car broke down in the middle of nowhere.
examples.zh: 我們的車在荒郊野外拋錨了。

examples.en: The hotel is beautiful, but it's in the middle of nowhere.
examples.zh: 飯店很美，但在很偏僻的地方。

slang.usage: 形容高樓林立、缺乏自然的大城市。

examples.en: Taipei can feel like a concrete jungle, but the mountains are close.
examples.zh: 台北有時感覺像水泥叢林，但山離得很近。

examples.en: I need to escape the concrete jungle this weekend.
examples.zh: 我這週末需要逃離水泥叢林。

slang.usage: the sticks = 鄉下、偏遠地方，帶一點「很土」的調侃。

risk.note: 可能帶輕視鄉下的意味，自嘲可以，說別人家鄉要小心。

examples.en: My grandparents live way out in the sticks.
examples.zh: 我爺爺奶奶住在很偏僻的鄉下。

examples.en: There's no good Wi-Fi out here in the sticks.
examples.zh: 這個鄉下地方沒什麼好的 Wi-Fi。

review.question: I wish I ___ closer to the mountains.
review.explanation: 複習第 68 單元：wish + 過去式。

review.question: I could hear the waves ___ (crash) all night.
He moved to the countryside ___ save money.
Rural towns are said ___ losing young people.
review.explanation: 複習第 61 單元：is said to + V。

review.question: The city is exciting. ___, it's exhausting.
There aren't ___ restaurants in my village.
review.explanation: 複習第 5 單元：否定用 any。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: The more far, the more cheap.
review.explanation: The + 比較級, the + 比較級。
